snippet.title: MONO CHAMELEON - Launch Trailer | Paint yourself into the wall (Steam, Nov 5)
snippet.description: MONO CHAMELEON is online hide-and-seek on a retro handheld-style screen: four monochrome shades of olive and cream. Hiders sample the bricks and the mortar from a wall and paint themselves until they melt into it. Seekers have no radar that shows hiders: they rely on their eyes. Five modes, 2-10 players, bots fill empty slots.Out on Steam November 5, 2026 · $5.99 · 20% off for the first two weeks.Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/910550/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=mcch_trailer_en#indiegame #hideandseek #steam
